caption:
25% faster doesn't mean 25% less time.

Time = distance ÷ speed, so the new time is the old time divided by 1.25. Turn that into a percent decrease.

Follow @samsonsatprep for more rate traps.
tiktok_caption: 25% faster isn't 25% less time. Divide by 1.25 and see.
